what: the Conductor honesty & integrity card: every behavior that moves money (flip-harvest, fee-clear, conviction sizing, throttle) is A/B-graded against its own null, with pre-registered kill criteria. C0/C1 remain analysis-only; nothing here grants the Master trading rights.

harvest_ab.read: selling on the flip has PAID so far (median saved 2.49%)
harvest_ab.kill_criterion: median 24h saved_pct ≤ 0 after 60 graded events → set regime_exit.mode=off

sizing_ab.read: conviction sizing has out-earned flat sizing by $87.39
sizing_ab.kill_criterion: extra ≤ $0 after 60 closed sized trades → set conviction_sizing.mode=off

stuck_capital.read: underwater ≥72h — the Conductor's cost line; fee-clear frees the green ones automatically

crash_avoidance.read: Δ-vs-HODL is the crash referee: positive through red windows = the harvest/throttle earned its keep

integrity.note: wins booked on an oscillation-quarantined tape count here, not in the headline; recorder two-print confirmation ends the class

realized_profit.note: the honest 'do we have profits' number: realized only, fees inside. Tracked as accounting — no sweep trades, no extra fees (the SGOV question, answered).
